params.1274: Use two batches of soft clay with a potter's wheel to make an urn.
params.1275: Fire the urn in a pottery oven.
params.1276: Attach the appropriate rune to the urn.
params.1277: If you would like more information about urns, speak to Ernie in the pottery building in Varrock.
params.2225: Activated urns provide a bonus to your experience gathering. To use it, train a skill while an appropriate urn is in your inventory until it is full, then teleport the urn to Ernie.
